findings.summary: Mixing table announcement truncates ingredient lists to 3 items with (+N) suffix, preventing screen reader users from hearing all 4-5+ constituent ingredients of the mixture.
findings.fix: Format the live region announcement to include the full list of constituent ingredients: const allNames = names.join(', '); announceNVDA(`Đã ${actionVerb} ${names.length} nguyên liệu (${allNames}) thành "${mixedItem.name}".${nextHint}`, 'polite');
findings.evidence: const previewNames = names.slice(0, 3).join(' & '); const extraSuffix = names.length > 3 ? ` (+${names.length - 3})` : ''; const defaultMixedName = `${previewNames}${extraSuffix} (${methodLabel})`;

findings.summary: Blender station announcement silences ingredients beyond the first 3 when blending 4 or more ingredients, leaving screen reader users unaware of all blended ingredients.
findings.fix: Include all constituent ingredients in the announcement: const allBlended = names.join(', '); announceNVDA(`Máy xay đã xay nhuyễn ${names.length} nguyên liệu (${allBlended}) thành món "${blendedItem.name}" sánh mịn ${coldBlendedPhrase}!`, 'polite');
findings.evidence: const defaultBlendName = `${names.slice(0, 3).join(' & ')} (xay nhuyễn)`; ... announceNVDA(`Máy xay đã xay nhuyễn tất cả thành món "${blendedItem.name}" sánh mịn ${coldBlendedPhrase}!`, 'polite');

findings.summary: announceNVDA does not cancel pending setTimeout calls across dual buffers, causing simultaneous live region updates and speech collisions if called within 60ms.
findings.fix: Track active timer IDs and clearTimeout before toggling or clearing buffers, ensuring previous pending speech triggers are canceled before new text is inserted into the alternating region.
findings.evidence: state.liveToggleBuffer = !state.liveToggleBuffer; ... if (clearEl) clearEl.textContent = ''; if (targetEl) { targetEl.textContent = ''; setTimeout(() => { targetEl.textContent = message; }, 60); }

findings.summary: Tasting review and routine kitchen validation notices use aria-live='assertive' (role='alert'), unnecessarily interrupting user navigation for non-emergency status updates.
findings.fix: Reserve priority='assertive' strictly for critical system errors. Switch routine dining reviews, empty kitchen notices, and validation guidance to priority='polite' so screen readers do not interrupt in-flight speech.
findings.evidence: announceNVDA(`${char.name} vừa thưởng thức ${finalDishTitle}. Nhận xét: ${review.speech}`, 'assertive'); ... announceNVDA('Không có thức ăn nào trên bếp để cất vào Khay Tạm!', 'assertive');

findings.summary: Constituent ingredients summary of plated dishes is hidden with display:none (hidden sm:inline), preventing mobile screen reader users from hearing dish ingredients on the plate.
findings.fix: Replace class 'hidden sm:inline' with a visually hidden utility class (such as 'sr-only sm:not-sr-only') or expose the summary in aria-label so screen readers on mobile devices can announce the constituent ingredients.

findings.summary: Authentication alert containers use Tailwind 'hidden' (display: none), removing them from the accessibility tree and risking failed announcements when text is inserted dynamically.
findings.fix: Remove 'hidden' from initial HTML and keep the live region in the DOM with empty textContent, or use visually hidden styling instead of display:none when inactive so screen readers register the live region before error dispatch.

passed: Dual polite live regions (#nvda-live-polite-a, #nvda-live-polite-b) are present in the DOM on initial load before any user interaction
Live region DOM text content is updated using textContent rather than innerHTML or node replacement
Live regions are styled with .sr-only-live offscreen clipping rather than display: none or visibility: hidden
Asynchronous operations (baking, frying, mixing, feeding) announce processing state (isCookingBusy, isFeedingBusy) to provide immediate feedback
Staging tray transfers (moveStationToStaging, moveStagingToStation) announce exact item counts and names to live regions
Spice applications announce spice name, target location (station vs staging), and layered outer-wrapper seasoning accurately
Station selection and kitchen tab switching update live regions with station names and hotkey instructions
notes: Project implements dual-buffer ARIA live regions (#nvda-live-polite-a / #nvda-live-polite-b and #nvda-live-assertive-a / #nvda-live-assertive-b) rather than a single #nvda-live-region container to guarantee NVDA re-announces identical consecutive messages.
When testing 4-5+ ingredients at the Mixing Table, visual brevity in mixedItem.name currently causes (+N) truncation to leak into speech announcements unless specifically formatted in announceNVDA.
